description:
Lamivudine 150mg — 60 Tablets (Generic for Epivir®) is an antiviral medication formulated to support the management of viral infections under medical supervision. Each dose is manufactured to pharmaceutical-grade standards and stored at our Cabo San Lucas facility for fast local delivery.

Typical use is determined by your prescribing physician and may vary based on the type of viral infection, severity, and individual response. Always follow the dosage schedule provided in your prescription. Consult your healthcare provider before starting, modifying, or discontinuing therapy.

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1) before dispensing. Delivery available 24/7 to hotels and residences in Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo.
